theorem lg_target {R : Type u} [Ring R] : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasFiniteBiproducts (ModuleCat R) := by
  apply CategoryTheory.Limits.HasFiniteBiproducts.of_has_zero_object_and_finite_products_and_coproducts
  refine { has_zero_object := ModuleCat.instHasZeroObject, has_finite_products := ModuleCat.hasLimits', has_finite_coproducts := ModuleCat.instHasFiniteColimits }
